impact: Direct lift for MU and DRAM after a month of losses; the rebound still depends on yields, with bonds reopening Thursday after Veterans Day and PPI due Friday, and MU reports Dec 16 (options price about ±9%).
summary: Micron rose as much as about 13% on Wednesday to around $824, reversing a monthlong slide, as CoreWeave's Q3 beat eased worries about AI compute demand. Morgan Stanley said the recent valuation pullback improves memory stocks' risk-reward. SanDisk and Western Digital also rallied.
title: Micron jumps ~13% as CoreWeave beat and Morgan Stanley revive memory
